dialogues.jp: 「やばいな」
スタートが遅れたか……。

ほんの１・２分の違いなのだが、朝のこの時間
においては、致命的な差となって結果に現れる。
dialogues.en:
It's only a matter of one or two minutes, but it makes a
huge difference in the morning.
dialogues.text:
It's only a matter of one or two minutes, but it makes a
huge difference in the morning.

dialogues.jp: ――遅刻。
その２文字が頭をよぎる。
まだ諦めるのは早い。
dialogues.en: It's too early to give up yet.
dialogues.text: It's too early to give up yet.

dialogues.jp: 「ぐはっ……」
走るのをやめ、力尽きるように地に膝を着く。
dialogues.en: I stopped running and fell onto my knees.
dialogues.text: I stopped running and fell onto my knees.

dialogues.jp:
これで遅刻は決定か。今週は音夢が風紀委員と
して校門に立っている。
dialogues.en:
Now I'm officially late. Nemu will be at the gate to watch
for students like me.
dialogues.text:
Now I'm officially late. Nemu will be at the gate to watch
for students like me.

dialogues.jp: このまま校門にいけば……。
「しばかれるのは確実だな」
dialogues.en: "I'm sure she'll give me a hard time."
dialogues.text: "I'm sure she'll give me a hard time."

dialogues.jp: 裏からまわるか……。
dialogues.en: Maybe I can get in from the back......
dialogues.text: Maybe I can get in from the back......

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あ、朝倉くん」

本鈴などお構いなしに、萌先輩が木琴を叩きな
がら歩いてくる。
dialogues.en: Moe-sempai was walking while playing her xylophone.
dialogues.text: Moe-sempai was walking while playing her xylophone.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「どうしたんですか？」

地べたに｛ひざまず／跪｝く俺を見下ろして、萌先輩が演奏を
やめる。
dialogues.en: She stopped playing and looked down at me on the ground.
dialogues.text: She stopped playing and looked down at me on the ground.

dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと疲れたんで休憩を」
dialogues.en: "I was just taking a little break."
dialogues.text: "I was just taking a little break."

dialogues.jp: 立ち上がり、膝の土を払い落とす。
dialogues.en: I stood up and dusted my knees.
dialogues.text: I stood up and dusted my knees.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「そうなんですか。具合が悪いんじゃなくて、
　よかったです」
dialogues.en:
"Is that so? It's good that you aren't feeling sick or
anything."
dialogues.text:
"Is that so? It's good that you aren't feeling sick or
anything."

dialogues.jp:
優しく微笑み萌先輩に、ちょっぴり｛みと／見惚｝れてし
まう。
dialogues.en: I stared at her gentle smile.
dialogues.text: I stared at her gentle smile.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あの、遅刻してますので早く行きましょう」
dialogues.en: "Um, let's get going before we're late."
dialogues.text: "Um, let's get going before we're late."

dialogues.jp: 俺を促すように萌先輩が一歩を踏み出す。
「あっ、萌先輩」

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい？」
足を止め、澄んだ瞳で俺を見つめる。
dialogues.en: She stopped again and stared at me.
dialogues.text: She stopped again and stared at me.

dialogues.jp: 「他の入り口から行きましょう」

さすがに、萌先輩をこのまま、音夢が待ち構え
る校門まで行かせるわけにはいかない。
dialogues.en: I couldn't let her go to the gate where Nemu was waiting.
dialogues.text: I couldn't let her go to the gate where Nemu was waiting.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「俺について来てください」

不思議がる萌先輩を強引に促し、学園の裏へと
誘導する。
dialogues.en: I dragged her towards the back of the school.
dialogues.text: I dragged her towards the back of the school.

dialogues.jp:
そんなに高くない塀だが、それでも地面に着地
したときに、軽く足に｛しび／痺｝れが走る。
dialogues.en:
The wall wasn't so high, but it still shook my legs when I
landed.
dialogues.text:
The wall wasn't so high, but it still shook my legs when I
landed.

dialogues.jp: 「さあ、次は萌先輩の番ですよ」
先輩を受け止めるため、後ろを振り返る。
dialogues.en: I turned around to catch her.
dialogues.text: I turned around to catch her.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉くん、あの……このあとどうすれば……」
困ったような萌先輩の声に、我に返る。
dialogues.en: My body froze when I saw her sitting on top of the wall.
dialogues.text: My body froze when I saw her sitting on top of the wall.

dialogues.jp:
「あ〜……えーと、俺が受け止めますから、そっ
　と飛び降りてください」
dialogues.en:
Her private area and the fabric covering it was exposed when
I looked up.
dialogues.text:
Her private area and the fabric covering it was exposed when
I looked up.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」

萌先輩が頷いて、塀についていない方の手を差
し出してくる。

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あの……こっちの手も……」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun, umm...... what do I do now......?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun, umm...... what do I do now......?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.en: Her voice brought me back to the reality.
dialogues.text: Her voice brought me back to the reality.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あの……飛び降りても大丈夫でしょうか？」

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「えぇ」
dialogues.en: "Can you...... hold the other hand too......?"
dialogues.text: "Can you...... hold the other hand too......?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「それじゃあ、お願いしますね」

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「よいしょ……っと」

なんでそこでわざわざ勢いを付けるんですか、
萌せんぱー、
「うごっ！？」
べちゃ――。
dialogues.en:
The bright spot went out of my view and something soft came
on top of me.
dialogues.text:
The bright spot went out of my view and something soft came
on top of me.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「だ、大丈夫ですか朝倉くん」

お腹の上に、萌先輩の重みを感じつつ、俺はし
ばらく暗闇をさまよい続けた……。
dialogues.en:
I blacked out for a while, but could still feel her weight
and softness on my stomach .......
dialogues.text:
I blacked out for a while, but could still feel her weight
and softness on my stomach .......

dialogues.jp: ◆萌先輩の塀越え◆

急いだのだが、遅刻が決定してしまった。正攻
法で行ったら、しばかれるな……。
dialogues.en:
I rushed, but I couldn't make it to school in time. I knew
I'd get in trouble if I tried to go in through the main
gate.......
dialogues.text:
I rushed, but I couldn't make it to school in time. I knew
I'd get in trouble if I tried to go in through the main
gate.......

dialogues.jp:
途中で会った萌先輩と共に、他の入り口を目指
した。
dialogues.en:
I ran into Moe-sempai, and we both went to the back of the
school to get in.
dialogues.text:
I ran into Moe-sempai, and we both went to the back of the
school to get in.

dialogues.jp: それが、こんな事になるなんて……。
嬉しいじゃねえか、おい。
